(2) The collector quotes this chain's start, then 'ثم ذكر مثل حديث ابي اميه', then a difference 'فاكسروها بالماء'. The collector says 'المعني واحد' (the two teachers agree in sense), so no wording is claimed for either; labelled shared. 'كان يقول' after 'ان نبي الله' is treated as the speech verb of the link and skipped. The collector's closing remark 'قال موسي والفخر' ends the wording.
Musa's extra word 'والفخر' is given by the collector after the matn ('قال موسي والفخر'). A shared wording must be the same for both chains, so it is left out.
al-Walid's addition ('وقال الوليد في حديثه فسالت راشدا ... خمس مائه سنه') belongs to this chain only. Only the collector has both chains, so it is his comment and ends the shared wording.
